definitions.gloss: omitted character; missing letter; dropped character
definitions.explanation: A character or letter that was accidentally left out of written text. A type of typographical error specific to missing characters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{脱字|だつじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a missing character in the document.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誤字|ごじ}→誤字：16131_goji⟧{脱字|だつじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check for typos and missing characters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{脱字|だつじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Because I wrote in a hurry, I ended up with many dropped characters.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the set phrase ⟦{誤字|ごじ}→誤字：16131_goji⟧{脱字|だつじ} (typos and missing characters), which is the standard way to refer to typographical errors in Japanese. ⟦{誤字|ごじ}→誤字：16131_goji⟧ means an incorrect character, while {脱字|だつじ} means a missing one. Together they cover the main types of writing errors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{誤字|ごじ}→誤字：16131_goji⟧{脱字|だつじ} (typos and omissions — the standard pair)
- {脱字|だつじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is a missing character)
- {脱字|だつじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す (to fix a missing character)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誤字|ごじ}→誤字：16131_goji⟧: wrong character — the complementary error type (writing the wrong character)
- ⟦{誤植|ごしょく}→誤植：23110_goshoku⟧: misprint, typo — specifically refers to printing errors
